name: Drush Webmaster: Redirect
description: Submodule of Drush Webmaster: wm:redirect:* Drush commands to list, search, create, update, delete, import (CSV) and export URL redirects for AI-assisted site administration.
project_description: Drush Webmaster: Redirect is a submodule of Drush Webmaster that adds wm:redirect:* Drush commands for managing URL redirects from the command line, aimed at AI-assisted site administration. It lets an agent or webmaster list and filter redirects, search or find by source/target path, create/update/delete redirects, view statistics, and bulk import/export via CSV. It depends on the base Drush Webmaster module and the contributed Redirect module. This is a 1.0.0-beta1 pre-release.
